newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - August 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - August 4.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Chinese communists leader Jiang Zemin launches series of political actions.
Four Taiwan sailors caught for smuggling counterfeit renminbi.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Chiao Tung Bank to auction 400 million shares.
Huang Kun-huei, President Lee Teng-hui's chief of staff, says no meeting planned between President Lee and Taiwan governor James Soong.
LIBERTY TIMES - Taiwan hopes to join World Trade Organisation in May or June 1998.
Defence ministry eyes Guam for troops' overseas training.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taipei International Computer Show kicks off.
Key economic and financial positions face major shake-up during cabinet reshuffle.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Chinatrust Commercial eyes global expansion.
Employees get six-day holiday for lunar Chinese New Year in 1998.
